ItemID: NA; Title: Shadows in the Night; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Traditional vocal standards are outside the blues and roots rock I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing right now than songs with bluesy vocals and guitar.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Tom Petty fits my interest in Benmont Tench, but I would save this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: CSNY 1974; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy songwriting appeals, but I am not looking for a large live collection today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful blues and slide guitar fit my taste, though I would only browse this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Old Sock, I would choose more Clapton, especially relaxed JJ Cale songs.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Johnny Winter's guitar-driven blues connects strongly with my interest in Hendrix and Clapton.
ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country and roots direction interests me, but blues is my stronger preference today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Earthy songwriting and roots music appeal, but I would postpone exploring this album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Stones playing blues sounds relevant, but I would stick with my two strongest choices today.
